entities.summary: Giovanni Niccolò was a Jesuit Italian painter who in 1583 was sent to found a seminary of painting, named the Seminary of Painters, in Japan. This painter's name was Giovanni Colla. He has become known as Giovanni Niccolò, but this is an error.
